name: Mandelbulb Isosurface Extraction via Marching Cubes
definition: A technique to generate a 3D mesh of the Mandelbulb fractal by computing a scalar field function on a 3D grid and extracting the isosurface using the marching cubes algorithm.
summary: Mandelbulb Isosurface Extraction via Marching Cubes generates a static, manipulable triangular mesh of the Mandelbulb fractal, differing from ray-traced rendering by producing a polygonal model for standard graphics pipelines.
